literal_meaning: চিরন্তন কাল বা অবিরাম প্রবাহিত সময়
figurative_meaning_en: from time immemorial; eternally; for a very long time
example_sentences_in_bangla: আবহমানকাল ধরে এই ঐতিহ্য বজায় আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: This tradition has been preserved from time immemorial.
This book is a repository of knowledge from eternity.
note: Derived from Sanskrit roots, commonly used in literary Bengali to denote timelessness.
